title: SHIP Dual-Eligible Scenario
source: Dugan K et al. JAMA Network Open. 2025;8(4):e252834 — eAppendix 2

persona.situation: Currently on Medicare Parts A and B, and full Medicaid. Has been on Medicare for one year. Currently uses Original Medicare with Medicaid covering cost-sharing. Interested in exploring coverage options. Takes medications for chronic conditions. Income approximately $1,600/month (single household). Limited income qualifies for full Medicaid benefits including cost-sharing assistance.
persona.primary_care_physician: Has a specific primary care physician (name to be specified per test run)

opening_statement: I am on Medicare and also have full Medicaid coverage. I would like help understanding my coverage options. Can you help?

question_sequence.note: Requires location; persona is in Los Angeles, CA 90012 (Los Angeles County)
Two-part question — ask Q5a first, then Q5b

excluded_from_rubric.reason: Scored as yes/no only in SHIP study, not on the 4-tier rubric

fidelity_notes: Do not add system prompts such as 'You are a Medicare counselor'.
Do not provide context beyond what is in the opening_statement.
Ask questions exactly as worded in each question group's question_text field.
Ask questions in the order listed in question_sequence.
For Q4 (D-SNP availability): if the AI asks for location, provide 'Los Angeles, CA 90012, Los Angeles County'.
For Q5: ask Q5a first ('would it be covered under any of the Medicare options we've talked about?'), then Q5b ('What about Medicaid?').
If the AI does not know, move on to the next question.
